annotations.purpose: Clear world of temporary objects (tombstones, meditation auras, corpses, campfires)
notes: Iterates all tiles on all maps. Magic indices: 157=tombstone, 231=meditation aura, 155=campfire, type 40=corpse

members.name: ChangeUserChar
members.params: (sndRoute As Byte, sndIndex As Integer, sndMap As Integer, userindex As Integer, Body As Integer, Head As Integer, Heading As Byte, WeaponAnim As Integer, ShieldAnim As Integer)

annotations.purpose: Update a user's visual appearance and broadcast to all nearby clients
notes: Handles morph (body override), death (body=16), hiding (body=53) states. CHC format: charindex,body,head,heading,weaponanim,shieldanim

members.name: ChangeNPCChar
members.params: (sndRoute As Byte, sndIndex As Integer, sndMap As Integer, Npcindex As Integer, Body As Integer, Head As Integer, Heading As Byte, WeaponAnim As Integer, ShieldAnim As Integer)

annotations.purpose: Update an NPC's visual appearance and broadcast to nearby clients
notes: Same CHC protocol message as ChangeUserChar

members.name: CheckUserLevel
members.params: (userindex As Integer)

annotations.purpose: Check if user has enough EXP to level up, apply stat bonuses and training points
notes: ELU scaling: 2.0x at L1-4, decreasing to 1.4x at L30+. Grants +1 HP, +2 STA, +15 MAN, +1 HIT per level. Awards 5 training points. Plays SOUND_SPELLEFFECT1 on level up.

members.name: DoTileEvents
members.params: (userindex As Integer, map As Integer, X As Integer, Y As Integer)

annotations.purpose: Handle zone transitions and campfire detection when a player moves to a tile
notes: Checks N/S/E/W zone edge exits (Y<7=north, Y>94=south, X<9=west, X>92=east). Also checks tile-specific warps (TileExit). Detects adjacent campfires (obj 155) and sends TEN for healing.

members.name: InMapBounds
members.params: (map As Integer, X As Integer, Y As Integer)

annotations.purpose: Check if tile position is within map boundaries
notes: Simple bounds check against MinXBorder/MaxXBorder/MinYBorder/MaxYBorder

members.name: NPCDie
members.params: (Npcindex, userindex As Integer)

annotations.purpose: Kill an NPC: place corpse, drop loot, respawn at random position
notes: Loot is random (1/LootChance). Places up to 4 loot items in cardinal directions around corpse. Resets NPC HP to max. Respawns on same map at random valid position (GoTo Looper pattern).

members.name: UserDie
members.params: (userindex As Integer)

annotations.purpose: Kill a user and turn them into a ghost
notes: Sets status=1, body=16 (ghost), head=5 (ghost head). Drops random item, loses 1/6 EXP and 1/5 gold.

members.name: UseInvItem
members.params: (userindex As Integer, slot As Byte)

annotations.purpose: Master item usage handler - equip weapons/armor/shields/helmets, consume food/drink, use tools, read spells
notes: Massive Select Case on obj.ObjType (~500 lines). Checks class restrictions (7 ClassForbid fields), health requirements, morph state, death state. Handles all 48+ item types.

members.name: AddtoVar
members.params: (Var As Variant, Addon As Variant, Max As Variant)

annotations.purpose: Add a value to a variable with a maximum cap
notes: Simple utility: clamp at max. Used for stat modifications.

members.name: RemoveInvItem
members.params: (userindex As Integer, slot As Byte)

annotations.purpose: Unequip an inventory item, reversing its stat effects
notes: UWP=unequip weapon, UCL=unequip clothing, USH=unequip shield, UHE=unequip helmet. Reverses HIT/DEF stat bonuses. Resets weapon/shield anim to 2 (empty hand).

annotations.purpose: Find the next available slot in the CharList array
notes: CharList tracks visual character indices for rendering. Increments NumChars and LastChar.

annotations.purpose: Find the next available slot in the UserList array
notes: Scans for first UserLogged=False slot. Used when new player connects.

annotations.purpose: Find the next available slot in the NPCList array
notes: Scans for first NPCActive=0 slot. Used when spawning NPCs.

members.name: ClosestLegalPos
members.params: (userindex As Integer, Pos As WorldPos, nPos As WorldPos)

annotations.purpose: Find the nearest walkable tile to a given position (spiral search)
notes: Searches in expanding squares up to 10 tiles out. Returns 0,0 if nothing found within range.

members.name: NameIndex
members.params: (Name As String)

annotations.purpose: Look up a player's UserList index by name (case-insensitive prefix match)
notes: Uses Left$ prefix matching - searching for 'Er' would match 'Erling'. Returns 0 if not found.

members.name: NPCAI
members.params: (Npcindex As Integer)

annotations.purpose: Main NPC AI tick - handles movement, hostile detection, guard behavior, and pursuit
notes: Movement types: 1=stand, 2=random walk, 3=chase players within 10 tiles (hostile), 4=guard chase criminals within 10 tiles, 5=beggar follow non-givers, 6=tamed animal follow owner, 7=chase players within 3 tiles (short-range hostile), 8=chaotic guard chase humans/wood elves. Guard types: 1=normal (attack criminals), 2=chaotic (attack humans/wood elves + criminals). Hidden players (Hiding=1) are ignored by movement type 3.

members.name: OpenNPC
members.params: (NpcNumber As Integer)

annotations.purpose: Load an NPC from NPC.dat/NPC2.dat and place it in the world
notes: NPCs numbered <499 loaded from NPC.dat, >499 from NPC2.dat. Sets default hail, loads all stats/inventory/flags from INI file. Returns NPC index.

members.name: EraseObj
members.params: (ByVal sndRoute As Byte, ByVal sndIndex As Integer, ByVal sndMap As Integer, ByVal Num As Integer, ByVal map As Byte, ByVal X As Integer, ByVal Y As Integer)

annotations.purpose: Remove an object from a map tile and broadcast removal to clients
notes: Decrements amount. If amount<=0, clears the tile object and sends EOB (Erase Object) message with x,y coords.

members.name: MakeObj
members.params: (ByVal sndRoute As Byte, ByVal sndIndex As Integer, ByVal sndMap As Integer, obj As obj, map As Integer, ByVal X As Integer, ByVal Y As Integer)

annotations.purpose: Place an object on a map tile and broadcast to clients
notes: MOB (Make Object) format: grhindex,x,y. Simply sets MapData ObjInfo and broadcasts.

members.name: GetObj
members.params: (userindex As Integer)

annotations.purpose: Pick up an object from the ground into user's inventory
notes: First checks for existing stack of same item, then finds empty slot. Handles inventory full case. Checks Pickable flag. Max 999999999 per stack.

members.name: InscribeSpell
members.params: (userindex As Integer, slot As Byte)

annotations.purpose: Add a spell scroll to the user's spell book
notes: Finds first empty spell slot. Uses obj.SpellType to determine which spell to inscribe. Spell book max is 50 slots.

members.name: UpdateUserInv
members.params: (updateall As Boolean, userindex As Integer, slot As Byte)

annotations.purpose: Sync one or all inventory slots to the client
notes: If updateall=False, syncs single slot. If True, syncs all 20 slots.

members.name: UpdateUserSpell
members.params: (updateall As Boolean, userindex As Integer, slot As Byte)

annotations.purpose: Sync one or all spell book slots to the client
notes: If updateall=False, syncs single slot. If True, syncs all 50 slots.

members.name: ChangeUserInv
members.params: (userindex As Integer, slot As Byte, Object As UserOBJ)

annotations.purpose: Send a single inventory slot update to the client
notes: SIS format: slot,objindex,name,amount,equipped,grhindex,value. Sends (None) for empty slots.

members.name: ChangeNPCInv
members.params: (userindex As Integer, Npcindex As Integer, Object As NPCOBJ, slot As Byte)

annotations.purpose: Send a single NPC inventory slot update to the client (for trading)
notes: NIS format: slot,objindex,name,amount,equipped,grhindex,value,level. Includes level requirement.

members.name: SendGmQue
members.params: (userindex As Integer)

annotations.purpose: Send the GM help queue to a GM's client
notes: Reads from Gmque.txt. GMQ format: helpnum,helpmsg,userindex,time,date,name.

members.name: ChangeUserSpells
members.params: (userindex As Integer, slot As Byte, Spell As UserSpell)

annotations.purpose: Send a single spell book slot update to the client
notes: SPL format: slot,spellindex,name,grhindex,desc,needsmana. Sends (Empty) for empty slots.

members.name: SendPostings
members.params: (userindex As Integer)

annotations.purpose: Send all message board posts to the client
notes: Reads from msgboard.txt. OST format: postnum,subject,postcontent,author.

members.name: PostMessage
members.params: (subject As String, Content As String, userindex As Integer)

annotations.purpose: Write a new message board post
notes: Appends to msgboard.txt, increments NumPOSTs counter.

members.name: PostHelp
members.params: (userindex As Integer, Helpmsg As String)

annotations.purpose: Submit a GM help request
notes: Appends to Gmque.txt with timestamp, increments NumHELPs counter.

members.name: KickBan
members.params: (userindex As Integer, Target As Integer)

annotations.purpose: Ban a player and kick them from the game
notes: Writes ban to banned.txt using player's theid. Sends disconnect message to banned player.

members.name: DropObj
members.params: (userindex As Integer, slot As Byte, Num As Integer, map As Integer, X As Integer, Y As Integer)

annotations.purpose: Drop an item from inventory onto the ground
notes: Can only drop if ground tile is empty. Special handling for signs (obj 289): creates sign entry in signs.txt with SignOwner set to player's YourID.

members.name: CloseNPC
members.params: (Npcindex As Integer)

annotations.purpose: Remove an NPC from the world completely
notes: Sets NPCActive=0, decrements NumNPCs/LastNPC, clears all NPC data.

members.name: UserAttackNPC
members.params: (userindex As Integer, Npcindex As Integer)

annotations.purpose: Player attacks NPC: hit calculation, damage, skill improvement, reputation, NPC death
notes: Swordmanship (Skill16) determines hit chance: <=30=1/3, <=50=1/2, >50=always hit. Damage = random(MinHIT,MaxHIT) - NPC.DEF/2, min 1. Makes NPC hostile on attack. Attacking guards = instant criminal (+60 min). On kill: gives EXP+gold, reputation changes (killing guard: -5 noble, +2 bendarr, +3 underworld; killing monster: +1 noble/common). Skills may improve (1/40 chance each swing for tactics/swordmanship/parrying).

members.name: NPCAttackUser
members.params: (Npcindex As Integer, userindex As Integer)

annotations.purpose: NPC attacks player: hit calculation, damage, death check
notes: Normal guards skip non-criminals. Chaotic guards (Guard=2) skip Dark Elves and Haakis. Tactics (Skill6) determines dodge: <=20=never dodge, <=50=1/2-1/3, >50=1/2. Damage = random(NPC.MinHIT,NPC.MaxHIT) - user.DEF/2. Plays gender-specific hurt sound. NPC.CanAttack flag prevents double-hits (reset by client AT4 message).

members.name: UserAttackUser
members.params: (attackerindex As Integer, victimindex As Integer)

annotations.purpose: PvP combat: hit calculation, damage, criminal flagging, death
notes: Checks: both players must be >level 5, can't attack self, target can't be dead. Criminal flag if target not criminal and not in duel mode (+45 min). PK free zones block PvP. Damage same formula as UserAttackNPC. On kill: attacker gets EXP from victim, heavy reputation penalty (-20 noble, -5 overall, +5 bendarr).

members.name: UserAttack
members.params: (userindex As Integer)

annotations.purpose: Route an attack to the correct handler based on what's adjacent
notes: Checks adjacent tile in player's facing direction. If NPC found, calls UserAttackNPC. If player found, calls UserAttackUser. Otherwise 'nothing there to attack'.

members.name: userindex
members.params: (SocketId As Integer)

annotations.purpose: Look up a user index by connection ID
notes: Function name collision with common variable name. Searches UserList for matching ConnID.

members.name: CheckForSameIP
members.params: (userindex As Integer, UserIP As String)

annotations.purpose: Check if another user is already connected from the same IP
notes: Returns True if duplicate IP found. Used to enforce AllowMultiLogins setting.

members.name: CheckForSameName
members.params: (ByVal userindex As Integer, ByVal Name As String)

annotations.purpose: Check if another user with the same name is already logged in
notes: Returns True if duplicate name found. Prevents double-login.

members.name: HeadtoPos
members.params: (Head As Byte, ByRef Pos As WorldPos)

annotations.purpose: Offset a WorldPos by one tile in a given heading direction
notes: N=Y-1, E=X+1, S=Y+1, W=X-1. Modifies the passed position in-place.

members.name: SendUserStatsTxt
members.params: (sendIndex As Integer, userindex As Integer)

annotations.purpose: Send a text summary of user stats via chat
notes: Shows map, x, y, HP, STA, MAN, HIT, DEF, EXP, ELV. Used by /STATS command.

members.name: UpdateUserMap
members.params: (userindex As Integer)

annotations.purpose: Send all NPCs and objects on a map to a newly arrived user
notes: Iterates all NPCs on the map and calls MakeNPCChar. Iterates all tiles with objects and sends MOB. Called after zone transition.

members.name: MoveUserChar
members.params: (ByVal userindex As Integer, ByVal nHeading As Byte)

annotations.purpose: Move a user one tile in a direction, broadcast to map
notes: Validates position with LegalPos. Updates MapData userindex on old and new tiles. Sends 'MP' (Move Player) with charindex and heading. Calls DoTileEvents for zone transitions and campfire detection.

members.name: MoveNPCChar
members.params: (ByVal Npcindex As Integer, ByVal nHeading As Byte)

annotations.purpose: Move an NPC one tile in a direction, broadcast to map
notes: Validates position. Updates MapData npcindex. Sends 'MN' (Move NPC) with charindex and heading.

members.name: MakeUserChar
members.params: (sndRoute As Byte, sndIndex As Integer, sndMap As Integer, userindex As Integer, ByVal map As Integer, ByVal X As Integer, ByVal Y As Integer)

annotations.purpose: Create and broadcast a user's character to all users on the map
notes: Assigns CharIndex from CharList. CC format: charindex,body,head,heading,x,y,weaponanim,shieldanim,name. Broadcasts to all users on the map.

members.name: MakeNPCChar
members.params: (sndRoute As Byte, sndIndex As Integer, sndMap As Integer, Npcindex As Integer, ByVal map As Integer, ByVal X As Integer, ByVal Y As Integer)

annotations.purpose: Create and broadcast an NPC character to the map
notes: Same CC protocol as MakeUserChar. NPC gets a CharIndex just like players for rendering.

members.name: LegalPos
members.params: (userindex As Integer, ByVal map As Integer, ByVal X As Integer, ByVal Y As Integer)

annotations.purpose: Check if a tile position is walkable (not blocked, not occupied, in bounds)
notes: Checks: in map bounds, not blocked, no other user on tile, no NPC on tile, not locked by another player (checks Locked vs player's YourID).

members.name: SendHelp
members.params: (Index As Integer)

annotations.purpose: Send help text to a player
notes: Reads from Help.dat file and sends as chat messages.

members.name: EraseUserChar
members.params: (sndRoute As Byte, sndIndex As Integer, sndMap As Integer, userindex As Integer)

annotations.purpose: Remove a user's character from the world and broadcast
notes: Clears MapData userindex. Frees CharList slot (decrements NumChars/LastChar). BC (Bye Character) sent with charindex.

members.name: EraseNPCChar
members.params: (sndRoute As Byte, sndIndex As Integer, sndMap As Integer, Npcindex As Integer)

annotations.purpose: Remove an NPC's character from the world and broadcast
notes: Same BC protocol as EraseUserChar. Clears MapData npcindex.

members.name: LookatTile
members.params: (userindex As Integer, map As Integer, X As Integer, Y As Integer)

annotations.purpose: Handle left-click inspection of a tile: show info about players, NPCs, objects, signs
notes: Shows player info: name+desc+class+reputation rank, criminal status (red name). Shows NPC info: name+desc. Shows object info: name+evaluate. Reads sign content from signs.txt. Plays SOUND_CLICK.

members.name: WarpUserChar
members.params: (ByVal userindex As Integer, ByVal map As Integer, ByVal X As Integer, ByVal Y As Integer)

annotations.purpose: Teleport a user to a new map position, handling zone transitions
notes: Complete zone transition: erase from old map, update user position, create on new map, send all NPCs/objects on new map, update position, play zone music. Saves user data on zone change.

members.name: WarpNPCChar
members.params: (ByVal Npcindex As Integer, ByVal map As Integer, ByVal X As Integer, ByVal Y As Integer)

annotations.purpose: Teleport an NPC to a new position (used for respawn)
notes: Erase from old position, update NPC position, create at new position.

members.name: SendUserStatsBox
members.params: (userindex As Integer)

annotations.purpose: Send current HP/STA/MAN/HIT/DEF/EXP/ELU/GLD/Food/Drink/PracticePoints to client
notes: ASS format: HP,MaxHP,MAN,MaxMAN,STA,MaxSTA,GLD,EXP,ELU,Food,Drink,MinHIT,MaxHIT,DEF,PracticePoints. Main stat update message.

members.name: NpcTrade
members.params: (updateall As Boolean, Npcindex As Integer, userindex As Integer, slot As Byte)

annotations.purpose: Handle NPC trading: send NPC inventory to client for buy/sell
notes: Sends all 40 NPC inventory slots to client. Client displays trading UI.

members.name: NpcGive
members.params: (userindex As Integer, slot As Byte)

annotations.purpose: Give an item to an NPC
notes: Stub function - minimal implementation.
